note: After Emerson's (1925) original description of the new species (in English), placed in the original under the subgenus Nasutitermes (Subulitermes), later assigned to Atlantitermes; the alate is described from a single queen and the soldier from two colonies. The author noted that this species differs from N. thompsonae and N. microsoma in that the head capsule is not covered with minute hairs.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, broadly oval, covered with long setae and hairs. Fontanelle pore about as long as an ocellus, forked at the apex. Antennal segments 2, 3 and 4 about equal in length, segment 3 the narrowest and just separate from segment 4. Compound eyes projecting, rather large, close to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli large and projecting, about one quarter of their own length from the compound eyes. Labrum brownish yellow. Postclypeus slightly paler than the head, median suture present. Pronotum almost as dark as the head, with an indistinct T-shaped pale spot in the middle; rather wide, the sides only slightly rounded, posterior margin nearly straight, the posterior corners rather distinctly rounded. Posterior margins of mesonotum and metanotum broadly concave. Abdominal tergites about the same colour as the pronotum.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, oval in dorsal view, with a slight constriction behind the antennal bases, the lateral outline from the rostral base to the posterior margin convex; smooth except for 4 setae at the rostral base and 2 on the vertex. Antennae 11—12-segmented, the basal segments variable in size. Rostrum brown, slender and long, the apex covered with minute hairs. Thorax pale. Pronotum with short hairs and several long setae at the anterior margin. Abdominal tergites with very short hairs and a row of setae at the posterior margin; pale.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate (queen) measurements (mm): head length 1.08; head width 1.03; compound eye diameter 0.30; pronotum length 0.52, width 0.87; hind tibia length 1.17; queen body length 16.00, abdominal width 3.00. Soldier measurements (mm): body length 3.50—4.50; head length 1.22—1.38; head width 0.69—0.77; antennal length 1.22—1.33; pronotum width 0.43; hind tibia length 0.73—0.75. Type locality Kartabo, British Guiana; holotype a queen, morphotype a soldier; described from the same queen and numerous soldiers from two colonies.
